name: Bernards Township (United States)
description: Quartered yellow and dark red for the four communities of Basking Ridge, Liberty Corner, Lyons and West Millington, with a white oak leaf on the upper hoist quarter and a yellow oak leaf on the lower hoist quarter, bound in white.
history: Bernards Township is a township in Somerset County, in New Jersey. The flag was adopted in 1960 (created by James Fogelman in 1960 for a bicentennial committee and revived by a local history organisation in 2022, according to Flags of the World citing TAPinto).
